Petersfield Secondary School has a standard procedure for approving field trips, requiring sign-off from the principal. The geography department's proposed coastal field trip has run without incident for four years. This year, a new coach operator is contracted, and the risk-assessment form requires an extra signature from the deputy head, who is on leave until late September. The half-term deadline for sending parental consent letters is approaching; the exact date is known to the school administration.
